Consts

ReminderToolDescription = "Schedule a proactive message to the user at a future time. Use this whenever the user asks to be reminded about something at a specific time or after a delay. IMPORTANT: always convert the user\'s local time to an absolute ISO 8601 string with timezone offset before calling this tool (e.g. \"2025-03-18T17:25:00-03:00\"). Alternatively, use a relative offset: +30m (30 minutes), +2h (2 hours), +1d (1 day). The reminder text is delivered later as a normal outbound message."

func parseWhen(whenStr: string; nowSec: int64): int64 {....raises: [ValueError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}

Parses a "when" string into a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC).

Accepted formats: Relative: +30m, +2h, +1d (minutes / hours / days from now) Absolute: ISO 8601 with tz 2025-03-18T17:25:00-03:00 ISO 8601 UTC 2025-03-18T17:25:00Z

Falls back to now+1h on unrecognised input.
